## Rowan Brad Quni-Gudzinas
Independent researcher. Founder of QNFO (Quantum Foundations / Non-Foundational Ontology). Sole human author of all QNFO content (ADR-014). ORCID: 0009-0002-4317-5604. GitHub: rwnq8. Bluesky: qnfo.bsky.social.

## Research Programs (Five Pillars)
- UMP — Ultrametric Physics: p-adic physics, ultrametric quantum computing, Adelic QFT, Bruhat-Tits trees
- SLB — Laws of Form: Spencer-Brown calculus, Autaxys QC, primary algebra
- INM — Information Physics: Adelic Shannon theory, measurement stratigraphy
- CFE — Paradigm Engineering: KIF gates, Bayesian evidential weight (KIF-60), epistemic hygiene
- RES — Consilience: cross-domain synthesis, KIF-29, valuation theory, Ostrowski's theorem
